title: The Magic Pudding Being the Adventures of Bunyip Bluegum and His Friends Bill Barnacle & Sam Sawnoff

Together, they must defend their temperamental talking dessert from cunning Pudding Thieves who devise increasingly elaborate schemes to steal it.
